Class BillSelector

public inherited sharing class BillSelector

Selector (data access layer) for the Bill__c custom object. Provides centralized SOQL query methods with standardized Result handling for bill retrieval, including related payment and commission data.

Group:
    Selector Classes

Since:
    06/20/2021

Version:
    1.9


Change Log

  • 06/20/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 07/19/2021 - v1.1 - Methods getBills() and getBillsWithPayments().
  • 09/09/2021 - v1.2 - getBills(), getBillsWithPayments(): Add field BlazeBiteFixedFees__c.
  • 09/28/2021 - v1.3 - getBills(), getBillsWithPayments(): Add field NumberOfPaymentsCharged__c.
  • 09/29/2021 - v1.4 - getBills(), getBillsWithPayments(): Add field NumberOfPaymentsRefunded__c.
  • 06/15/2024 - v1.5 - getBills(), getBillsWithPayments(): Add fields ProcessingFees__c and Account__r.BlazeBiteFeesIncludeCreditCardFees__c. Update API version to 60. Add new comments style.
  • 06/16/2024 - v1.6 - getBillsToCalculateCommissionsFor(): New method to query with account agents and total.
  • 08/26/2024 - v1.7 - getBillByDates(): New method to query for a given account Id and date range.
  • 10/05/2025 - v1.8 - Add encoded adjustment fields to getBills() and getBillsWithPayments().
  • 02/27/2026 - v1.9 - Update API version to 66.0. Remove encoded adjustment fields from getBills() and getBillsWithPayments().

public static BillSelector.Result getBillAccount(Id billId)

Queries the Account__c field for a given bill Id.

Parameters:
    billId – The Id of the Bill__c record to query.

Returns:
    Result: The query result containing the bill with its Account__c field.

public static BillSelector.Result getBillByDates(
  String accountId,
  Date dateFrom,
  Date dateTo
)

Queries a Bill__c record matching the given account Id and exact sales period date range (SalesPeriodFrom__c / SalesPeriodTo__c).

Parameters:
    accountId – The account Id to query bills for.
    dateFrom – The start date of the sales period.
    dateTo – The end date of the sales period.

Returns:
    Result: The query result containing the matching bill, if found.
